assessment: This paper presents an elegant and multidisciplinary study combining state-of-the-art NMR with computational modeling methods, to characterize the effects of mutations on the structure and allosteric communication within the CRISPR-Cas9 system. In revealing the link between the allosteric network in the protein and the increase in CRISPR-Cas9 specificity, this study carries important implications for the design of new gene editing tools.
